items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Count Basie) narrates a story about Bus Moten receiving a call about Benny Moten's death, but does not describe a personal relationship with Bus Moten himself.

ctx.x: Just 60 miles or something like that.

"I've heard a lot of conflicting stories as to how I came to go out as a band leader in my own right. First I will say that I did not take over the Benny Moten Band when Benny died. In 1935, the band was booked for the Rainbow Ballroom in Denver, one of the leading dance spots in the West. Benny, however, stayed in Kansas City for a tonsillectomy. In the meantime, the band went on to open in Denver." So you were then at piano. "Just as we were getting underway on opening night, Bus Moten received a telephone call…
